figure37_caption.text: Figure 37. Overall structure, hardware components, and control circuit of the device.(A) Exploded view showing the functional modules, including the RK3588 SoC–based artificial intelligence module, AP6256 Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth communication module, optical module (camera and filter), LED chip, temperature module (heating plate and heating element), and power module (lithium battery and charging chip); (B) front (left) and back (right) views of the RK3588 core control board; (C) photograph and dimensions of the assembled device (14 cm × 7.5 cm × 11 cm); and (D) schematic diagram of the temperature-module drive and control circuit.
